column1: # Григорий Войнер's files that do not follow the naming rule.  The rule: PP-SS.mp3, the
# paper in two digits or three, is section PP:SS from its start, spoken heading first;
# 139-09-10 is the combined 139:9.  Every other file must be named here, with the
# paragraph it begins at or '-' for a file the site does not use, and why.  Measured 2026-11-12.
# None now.  Until 2026-11-21 three were, second copies under another section's name,
# none of them used: 7-07.mp3 (75:7 again), 19-00.mp3 (192:0 again) and 50-00.mp3 (the
# first 176 s of 50:4 again).  Heard again that day against the files they copy, and
